Testimonials.review1Text: The ultimate hunting destination in Malatya. They guided me thoroughly through firearm selection and license paperwork. Extremely courteous and knowledgeable gentlemen.
Testimonials.review2Text: Purchased tactical optics and flashlights here. Tired of grey-market counterfeits, Guner AV sells strictly authentic items with receipts and warranties. A true pleasure to visit.
Testimonials.review3Text: Outdoor apparel and boots selection far surpasses local standards. Found everything I needed under one roof. Full 5 stars well deserved.

About.title: About Guner AV
About.subtitle: Serving Malatya's Outdoor & Hunting Community with Integrity for over 30 Years
About.intro: Malatya Av Guner Hunting Dealer was founded to unite a deep passion for the outdoors with uncompromising professionalism. Located in Seyh Bayram, Yesilyurt, we provide premium gear to hunters, target shooters, and campers across the region.
About.missionText: We champion sustainable wildlife conservation, ethical hunting practices, and strict adherence to firearms safety laws. We only carry authorized products and actively mentor new generations in outdoor safety.
About.point1: Fully certified and licensed firearms and ammunition dealership
About.point2: 100% authentic distributor-backed inventory from top global manufacturers
About.point3: Comprehensive pre-purchase consultation and after-sales maintenance guidance
About.point4: Proud recipient of a pristine 5.0 Google rating built on decades of trust
